Orthographic top-down photography, consistent neutral diffuse illumination, no perspective, directional cast shadows, horizon, objects or baked specular glare. Dense realistic microtexture, naturally varied midscale detail, rich organic game-quality materials; no checkerboard patterns or repeated obvious motifs.
